Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game but don't go anywhere as South Africa Women will take on New Zealand Women shortly. So switch the tabs and join us there. Cheers!

Heather Knight says they have got some superb spinners and they did a great job. Adds it was hard work in the end but two points are important. Shares that in this format, aggression is important. Feels they have good depth in the batting. Hopes for a great game against India.

Laura Delany says it is disappointing to lose but credit to England for the way they played. Adds their top three batted well and the next step is to keep the momentum going. Reckons they are looking forward to the game against Pakistan. Ends by thanking the crowd for the support.

Alice Capsey wins the Player of the Match. She says it is an honor to play for England. On her batting, she says she tries to put pressure on the bowler. Reckons they are confident and enjoying their time. Hopes to continue the way they are playing. On the wicket, it is staying low and holding a bit.
... Presentation time...

Ireland Women bowlers were too wayard in the start and that didn't help them. There was enough in the pitch to test the English batter but their bowling was not good enough. Just as we saw how England lost a bit, Ireland Women would have hoped to bowl much better. Credits to the English bowlers for the way they bowl, the spinners took 8 out of 10 wickets.

A comfortable win for England! They did crawl towards the target in the end but there was never a tense moment. Have to say it was the bowlers who put the two points on the plate. They keep down Ireland from a promising position and had a below-par total to chase. Alice Capsey turned up and looked in hurry as she scored a fifty. England Women were on course to chase it down quickly but lost few wickets and the win was just pushed back.

Just like Ireland, England did start to lose wickets in the later half but they reached the target with ease. Only if Ireland would have managed to score something around 150, the chase would have been tight.
FOUR! That will help! Full and outside off, Brunt drives it through covers for four runs. England Women win by 4 wickets.
On off, kept out.

OUT! England just cannot finish this off! A leggie, full and outside off. Jones swings across but miscues her shot. It goes high but nowhere as Laura Delany at covers takes the skier. 3 runs needed now.
Commentary.Howout: c Laura Delany b Cara Murray

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Floated on off, Jones comes down the track and smashes it down to long off for four.
That was close! Tossed up, outside off, Brunt taps it to cover and calls for a single. A bit of miscommunication but Jones makes in the end.
Outside off, slower. Brunt looks to dab it away but misses.

OUT! BOWLED! Knight goes after a struggling innings! Strange dismissal! Unlucky one to say!This is angled on the pads. Knight gets on her knee to sweep but misses. She probably gets hit on the gloves. It deflects and rolls back onto her stumps.
Fuller and outside off, Jones swings across but slices her shot high and it falls safely towards the cover region.
This is full and way outside off, Knight looks to sweep but misses.
Outside off, guided again straight to cover.
Fuller and outside off, Knight steps across and squeezes it out to cover.
Tossed up, outside off, blocked to cover.
9 runs needed now! On middle, worked to long on for one.
Very full and outside off, Jones pushes it to cover.
Around off, Knight drives it firmly but finds cover.
Full and on off, pushed to the left of the bowler who makes a half-stop.
FOUR! A boundary after quite a while! Full and outside off, Knight drives on the up over covers for four.
Fuller and on off, drilled to long on for a single.
One more run as Knight hits this length ball to long on.
On middle, Jones pushes it to long on for a single.
On off, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one.
Too slow, outside off, Knight reverse sweeps and finds short third man.
An arm ball on off, Knight keeps it out.
Outside off, Jones punches it to deep cover for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Jones slaps it to point.
One more run as Jones works it to long off.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on off, defended out.
Fuller and on middle, swept behind square on the leg side for two.
Short and on middle, Jones sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one.

OUT! TAKEN! England losing their shape a bit here! Tossed up on off, a leggie. Sciver tries to heave it across but plays off the outer part of the blade to long off where Amy Hunter takes a simple catch. 25 runs needed in 65 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Amy Hunter b Cara Murray

Commentary.Commentary: Touch short and on middle, Sciver pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, Knight reverse sweeps it to deep point for a single.
Outside off, Knight finds cover as she pushes it out.
Tossed up on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
Outside off, slapped to deep cover for one more.
Flat and outside off, Knight punches it to deep point for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers for one more.
Tossed up on middle. Knight reverse hits straight to cover.
Tossed up on off, Knight drops it to cover.
Outside off, cut through covers for two more.

OUT! RUN OUT! On middle, Wyatt punches it straight to the fielder at cover. That is in front of the fielder but Wyatt still went for a quick single which was never there. She was sent back from halfway mark and was found well short.
Short and outside off, Sciver punches it to deep cover for one.
Length and on off, bunted to square leg for a single.
Very full and outside off, driven to mid off.
Length and on off, tapped to point for one.
A single as this is hit to long on.

OUT! TAKEN! Capsey goes but she has played her part! This is full and wide of Capsey. The batter still swings and tries to go over long off but toe ends her shot. Leah Paul runs to her right, dives and takes a stunning catch. Can Ireland put some pressure back?
Commentary.Howout: c Leah Paul b Arlene Kelly

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, guided to point for one.
SIX! Fifty for Capsey in just 21 balls! She looks in hurry!  A high full toss but dipping into the batter. Capsey hangs back and smokes it over mid-wicket for a six. 16 off the over.
FOUR! It is not working for the bowler! This one is outside off now, slower one. Capsey skips down, waits and thumps it over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Clubbed! Length ball, around off, sits nicely for Capsey who goes back and powers it to long off for four.
On the pads, helped to square leg for one.
Well bowled! Flighted ball from around the wicket, outside off, Wyatt looks to drive but misses.
On middle, this is worked to deep square leg for one.
Misfield! Outside off, driven to covers and a misfield helps the batter to take a single.
FOUR! 50 up! Length ball, outside off, stays low again. Capsey looks to drive but cue ends her shot and it goes through the legs of keeper to third man for four.
On off, kept out.
FOUR! Poor delivery! Inconsistency is not helping Ireland! A full toss, angling on middle, Capsey heaves it behind square leg for four.
Full and outside off, driven to sweeper cover for one.
Very full and outside off, Wyatt fails to cut it away.
FOUR! That is three boundaries in a row! England on a mission! This is full and on off, stays ver low. Capsey slams it past mid on for another boundary.
FOUR! Overruns! Short and on middle. Capsey pulls, the deep mid-wicket fielder runs to the ball but it spins away and goes past her hand for a boundary.
FOUR! Good fielding but in vain! On middle, slower and Capsey foes for the reverse hit past short third man. The fielder gives a chase and flicks it back but the ball touched the ropes first.
Tossed up, outside off, dragged to deep mid-wicket for one.
A full toss on middle. Capsey heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, kept out.
Full and outside off, knocked to point.
FOUR! Good shot! Short and around off, in the arc for Wyatt who pulls it past mid-wicket for four.
Full and on off, worked to mid on for one.
Short in length and on the body. Capsey steps down the pitch to pull but misses and gets hit near the ribs.
Length and on off, tucked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Capsey wasting no time! Short ball on middle, this is pulled past mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! POWERED! Very full and on middle, was the slower one. Wyatt slogs it high and clears the long on fence.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Straight down the ground! On a length and on middle. Capsey hits it uppishly but wide of the bowler and down for four.
FOUR! Shot! Full and outside off, Capsey threads it through covers for a boundary.
On middle, eased to mid-wicket for a single.
Flat and outside off, Wyatt punches it to point.
Outside off, driven to mid off.

OUT! TAKEN! Perfect start for Ireland! Length ball on middle, not much pace there. Dunkley takes a step down and tries to go over mid on fails and gifts away her wicket as Arlene Kelly takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Arlene Kelly b Orla Prendergast

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! England are off the mark! Length ball, outside off, Dunkley pulls it in the gap to deep mid-wicket for four.
A lelngth ball on middle. Dunkley again blocks it out.
Length ball, outside off, Dunkley defends it out.
On a length and on off, blocked out.
